enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket up. Place hand under pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Adjust pillow. Yawn. Rub eyes. Turn to back. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side again.

Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over side. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Urinate. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and spoon. Close cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Pick up bowl. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in dishwasher. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close closet. Lay clothes on bed. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Pack laptop. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office. Open office door. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator at a nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Take notes. Make phone calls. Talk to colleagues. Write reports. Print documents. Attend another meeting. Update database. Organize files. Prepare presentation.

Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Clear tray. Walk outside. Walk around block. Return to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator at a nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Check emails. Make phone calls. Meet with community partners. Take notes. Draft proposal. Review budget. Send emails. Attend conference call. Print materials. File documents. Attend team meeting. Present ideas. Update social media. Respond to messages. Organize event. Call vendors. Confirm attendees. Pack up for day.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to grocery store. Buy groceries. Walk home. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil and meat. Stir. Add vegetables and sauce. Stir. Turn off cooker. Pick up plate. Serve food. Place plate on table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, using computer and phone, reading, using fan due to heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Check messages. Scroll social media. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read book. Put down book. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Browse internet. Watch video. Type email. Close laptop. Pick up phone. Play game. Put down phone. Turn off fan.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wait for hot water. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Hang towel. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Open closet. Take out pajamas. Close closet. Remove clothes. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Turn on fan. Pull back blanket. Lie down on bed. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe regularly. Turn to side. Bend knees. Pull blanket. Place hand under pillow. Remain still. Turn to other side. Stretch. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn again. Remain still.
